candidates.statement: HIGH-DIMENSIONAL KERNELS We shall now revisit existing approaches to high- dimensional kernels in order to highlight the differences between our proposed quaternion kernel framework and those based upon existing high-dimensional kernels.
(11) To show that KQ P is positive semideﬁnite, we shall ﬁrst consider its factorisation of the form KQ P(x, y) = φH(x)φ(y).
